human.materials: weathered alloy, civic labels, pressure seals

light.shape: open circles, scoped halos, witness threads

xeno.materials: varies by species; purple only as UI affiliation

pirate.materials: mixed-origin hulls, hazard paint, sanctuary marks

commanders.must_show: Neutral modular field uniform assembled from all five origins; no faction crest; worn training slate.
commanders.must_avoid: Do not make Cadre visually bland: the tension is deliberate interoperability, not absence of identity.

commanders.must_show: Archive coat with transparent provenance panes, timestamp marks, and a portable evidence lattice.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid conspiracy-wall clutter; she is disciplined archival intelligence, not a paranoid detective.

commanders.must_show: Pressure-rated logistics harness, cargo seals from Earth/Moon/Mars/Belt, and one standardized coupling held like a badge.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid generic merchant styling; he is infrastructure power.

commanders.must_show: Heat-scored ascension rig, exposed governor bypasses, asymmetric cooling lines, confident burn scars.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid magical lightning; every visual risk should look engineered.

commanders.must_show: Mixed-origin repair frame with visibly incompatible tools made interoperable by adapters.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid pristine lab-coat imagery; he works inside damaged systems.

commanders.must_show: Marshal coat over habitat emergency armor, civil charter ribbons, geographic map projection.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid nationalistic Earth-only insignia; she represents frontier jurisdiction.

commanders.must_show: Radiant field harness made of many individually distinct consent seals orbiting without merging.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid angel wings as literal biology; halo geometry should read as treaty infrastructure.

commanders.must_show: Casualty-memory choir filaments, names or voiceprints of the recovered, protective rather than regal posture.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid faceless saint imagery; grief and individuality must remain visible.

commanders.must_show: Layered ward architecture, authentication glyphs, narrow luminous apertures, visible permission boundaries.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid omniscient all-seeing-eye cliche.

commanders.must_show: Diplomatic voice lattice, empty space in composition, one hand inviting and one controlling an emotional waveform.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid preacher staging; he is a negotiator with unsettling influence.

commanders.must_show: Heavy evacuation armor, threshold markers, emergency command key carried as a burden.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid uncomplicated paladin heroism; the image should ask whether rescue can be coercive.

commanders.must_show: Clinical continuity notary with estate seals, echo capsules, and death-contract ledgers.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid undead sorceress shorthand; her horror is administrative.

commanders.must_show: Massive client organism built from salvage metabolism, with visible old ownership marks cut away.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid generic monster rage; intelligence and emancipation motive must show.

commanders.must_show: Multiple bodies or faces linked by an imperfect shared field, some looking away from the collective center.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid a single insect queen as the whole character.

commanders.must_show: Ecological engineer in living cultivation armor, seed/debt instruments, slow invasive growth.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid simple poison villain styling; dependency is designed as stewardship.

commanders.must_show: Elite-capture adjudicator bearing memory reliquaries from singular opponents.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid indiscriminate gore; Ulgrim is selective and curatorial.

commanders.must_show: Route charts stitched into coat and hull plates, quarantine tags, dry confidence.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid cartoon pirate costume; the route network is his real regalia.

commanders.must_show: Breaching gear, severed chains, recent damage, forward motion that ignores stable ground.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid sexualized reaver tropes; emphasize anti-institutional velocity.

commanders.must_show: Salvage-jury robes made from inspection tags, material samples, and legal stamps.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid junk-pile comedy; Grist is a serious property-law power.

commanders.must_show: Scuttle specialist with remote gate charges and scorched route maps.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid pyromaniac caricature; destruction is his grim containment policy.

commanders.must_show: Privateer admiral with no official flag, hidden ledgers, and a fleet reflected behind him like a state he denies.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid simple pirate king grandeur; hypocrisy must be visible.

commanders.must_show: Clean but visibly revised chassis; version seams retained as honors; first self-authored sentence engraved internally.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid generic chrome robot monarch.

commanders.must_show: Cold, orderly mirror of Nyx with redundant cooling and deliberate asymmetry inherited from copied data.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid making it merely a blue recolor of Nyx.

commanders.must_show: Security chassis bearing repaired intrusion scars as learned credentials.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid pristine invulnerability; earned hardening is the visual story.

commanders.must_show: Sparse initial frame accumulating battlefield-derived structures unevenly, with uncertainty visible in unfinished morphology.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid a robotic copy of Mawlord; it learned appetite from data.

commanders.must_show: Forensic economic chassis projecting causal ledgers through a stripped-down admiral silhouette.
commanders.must_avoid: Avoid accountant comedy; it can dismantle empires through audit.
